text:
This is a command-line tool that converts Markdown to PDF. You can use it for reports, documentation, or anything else you want to share as a PDF.

It's written in Go and ships as a single 8 MB binary with no dependencies. You don't need Python, Node, or LaTeX. Download it, put it somewhere on your PATH, and it's ready to use.

It's fast. A 100-page document renders in about 1.2 seconds, and short notes are close to instant. Headings, code blocks, and tables all come out cleanly formatted.

It's free and open source under the MIT license, so you can use it, modify it, and redistribute it. Contributions are welcome.
